# mixed-noise: a synthetic router with every kind of netdev that is not a
# port, and ports that exercise labels, media and ordering.
#
# Ports: wan and lan1-lan3 are DSA user ports behind the conduit eth0; their
# device (the switch) carries a label of its own, which must not win over the
# port's own of_node/label. board.json lists LAN as lan3, lan1, lan2 (the
# order on the case, not the natural one) and WAN as the ports array
# ["sfp1", "wan"]. sfp1 has an SFP cage (of_node/sfp) and the label "SFP";
# eth3 has its cage and its label ("sfp2") on the device's of_node. eth2 is a
# USB NIC without any label. lan9 and lan10 are not on the board: natural
# order puts lan9 first. lan10 is a bond slave (bonding_slave/), which is
# still a port. wwan0 is an LTE modem in 802.3 mode (DEVTYPE=wwan): a port
# with medium "wireless".
#
# Noise: br-lan (DEVTYPE=bridge), br-guest (only bridge/ and brif/, no
# DEVTYPE), lan1.100 (DEVTYPE=vlan), bond0 (DEVTYPE=bond), bond1 (only
# bonding/), team0 (DEVTYPE=team), macvlan0 (iflink = a local ifindex, with
# lower_lan1), veth0 (a virtual NIC: reported only with VirtualAlways), ifb0,
# dummy0, tap0 (iflink == ifindex, no device), tun0 and wg0 (type 65534),
# gretap1 (iflink 0), wlan0 (DEVTYPE=wlan only), wlan1 (only a wireless/
# directory, but a device link), wlan2 (only phy80211/), can0 (a CAN bus
# controller: device-backed but type 280), broken0 (no type), gone0 (a
# dangling symlink), bonding_masters (a file) and lo.
#
# Format: see loadTree in ports_test.go.

-- etc/board.json --
{
	"model": {
		"id": "example,mixed-noise",
		"name": "Example mixed router"
	},
	"network": {
		"lan": {
			"ports": [
				"lan3",
				"lan1",
				"lan2"
			],
			"protocol": "static"
		},
		"wan": {
			"ports": [
				"sfp1",
				"wan"
			],
			"protocol": "dhcp"
		},
		"guest": {
			"device": "wlan0"
		}
	}
}

-- sys/class/net/bonding_masters --
bond0 bond1

-- sys/class/net/ --
gone0 -> ../../devices/virtual/net/gone0

-- sys/class/net/bond0/ --
type=1
ifindex=30
iflink=30
flags=0x1403
carrier=1
carrier_changes=1
operstate=up
speed=1000
duplex=full
address=02:00:00:00:06:30
uevent=DEVTYPE=bond\nINTERFACE=bond0\nIFINDEX=30
bonding/mode=active-backup 1
bonding/slaves=lan10
lower_lan10

-- sys/class/net/bond1/ --
type=1
ifindex=31
iflink=31
flags=0x1402
carrier_changes=0
operstate=down
address=02:00:00:00:06:31
uevent=INTERFACE=bond1\nIFINDEX=31
bonding/mode=balance-rr 0
bonding/slaves=
